nl: 报销单管理：查询有申请人；表格展示申请人、费用类型、金额、发票号；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「发票号」在金额不超过 100 元时隐藏（小额报销免票）。
nlEn: Expense-claim management: query by applicant; the table shows applicant, expense type, amount and invoice number; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "invoice number" is hidden when the amount does not exceed 100 (small claims need no invoice).
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（序关系 <=）—— 金额不超过 100 元时隐藏发票号（vue2/schema）
